caption:
Sarawak's GPS wins a record 29 state seats unopposed on nomination day

Gabungan Parti Sarawak needs 13 of the 53 remaining contested seats to secure a majority in the state election. Major parties from Peninsular Malaysia are sitting out the Sarawak polls. Analysts describe the scale of the walkovers as . A simple majority to form the state government takes 42 seats.

Reported by CNA; The Straits Times.
